source: 702 Fate Appropriator
target: 702 Fatum Appropriator

source: Before Lumian had a chance to say anything, Franca eagerly recounted the events involving the Underworld Daoist during the Dream Festival.
target: Antequam Lumian aliquid dicere poterat, Franca alacriter narravit eventus de Daoista Infernali in Festo Somniorum.

source: She said excitedly, “The interaction between our two worlds is even more intricate than I had imagined!”
target: Ea alacriter dixit: “Conexio inter nostros orbes etiam subtilior est quam putaveram!”

source: “Who would have thought there was another point of interaction beyond the Samaritan Women’s Spring, and it’s all tied to that mysterious illusory river.”
target: Quis putavit alium punctum communicationis ultra Fons Samaritarum Feminarum exsistere, atque omnia ad illum mysteriosum fluvium illusorium conexa esse?

source: Silently, Franca mused, It’s a shame we still haven’t located the man believed to be from our world who was seen on the fourth level of the catacombs…
target: Tacite, Franca meditabatur: “Paenitet quod nondum invenimus virum, qui ex nostro orbe esse creditur et qui in quarto gradu catacumbarum apparuit...”

source: Seriously, what’s taking 007, no—the Eternal Blazing Sun Church so long?
target: Serio, quid cunctatur 007, immo—Ecclesia Aeterni Solis Ardens ita diu?

source: They haven’t even tracked down the traitor who worked with April Fool’s…
target: Neque traditorem quidem, qui cum “Aprilis Insulso” operatus est, detexerunt…

source: Once Franca had finished speaking, Lumian provided a concise explanation of the origins of the black ancient tomb and the ancient corpse.
target: Postquam Franca finivit loqui, Lumian explicationem succinctam de origine sepulcri antiqui nigri et cadaveris antiqui praebuit.

source: Hela, still in her black widow attire, listened intently, gently nodding her head.
target: Hela, adhuc induta in habitu viduae nigrae, attente auscultabat et caput leniter annuens movebat.

source: “It’s now evident that the illusory river isn’t a reference to the River Styx.
target: Nunc perspicuum est flumen illusorium non referre ad flumen Styx.

source: It must be something far more significant than that.”
target: Id quidem esse debet aliquid multo grave.

source: “Absolutely.”
target: Certe.

source: Lumian wasn’t caught off guard by Hela’s statement.
target: Lumian verba Helae non obstupefactus fuit.

source: “The black ancient tomb doesn’t just embody the power of the Death pathway; it also represents the Evernight and Warrior pathways.”
target: Non solum sepulcrum antiquum nigrum vim viae Mortis complectitur, sed etiam iter Perpetuae Noctis et Bellatorum repraesentat.

source: In the current world, all the legends surrounding the River Styx were connected to death.
target: In mundo hodierno, omnes fabulae circa flumen Styx ad mortem coniunctae erant.

source: Lumian speculated that this might involve beings such as the Celestial Worthy of Heaven and Earth for Blessings, the Mother Tree of Desire, and the Great Mother, who held multiple thrones linked to various pathways.
target: Lumian coniecerat hoc fortasse implicare entia, ut Dignus Caelestis de Caelo et Terra pro Benedictionibus, Mater Arbor Desiderii, et Magna Mater, quae plura thronos ad varias viarum relationes nectos tenet.

source: Hela glanced at Franca, falling silent for a moment before speaking.
target: Hela Francae aspexit, paulisper tacita manens antequam loqui coepit.

source: “If the Armored Shadow is right, the Underworld Daoist is in a precarious state.
target: Si Umbra Armata recte censet, Daoista Infernalis in statu incerto versatur.

source: If you intend to interact with Him, you must exercise extreme caution and ensure you have an escape route from the corresponding area.”
target: Si cum eo colloqui vis, summa cautela utenda est, atque exitus via ex illa regione tibi praeparandus sit.

source: The Armored Shadow had described the Underworld Daoist as having “sacrificed himself to enter the river,” implying the sacrifice of one’s physical form or life.
target: Umbra Armata Daoistam Infernalis ita descripserat: “se ipsum sacrificavit ad flumen intrandum,” insinuans sacrificium corporis aut vitae.

source: “I understand.”
target: Intellego.

source: Franca let out a sigh.
target: Franca suspiravit.

source: “I’ll give this matter more thought once I reach Sequence 5.”
target: Hanc rem plenius meditabor, cum ad Sequenciam 5 perveniam.

source: As she sighed, a smug thought crossed her mind, The Pleasure potion has been largely digested lately.
target: Dum suspirabat, superbia cogitatio pervenit: “Potio Voluptatis nuper valde digesta est.”

source: Even without additional opportunities, I can start preparing for the Demoness of Affliction’s advancement ritual within two to three months…
target: Etiam sine ulterioribus occasionibus, intra duos ad tres menses ritum progressionis Daemones Afflictionis praeparare possum.

source: I need to begin gathering the necessary potion ingredients now…
target: Nunc incipere debeo necessaria potionis ingredientia colligere.

source: I can’t mention it, I mustn’t mention it—I can’t let Lumian know.
target: Id non dicere possum, non debeo dicere—non sinam Lumianum scire.

source: Bragging would make me seem crass and disrespectful to Jenna…
target: Iactantia me reddet ineptum ac contemptuosum in conspectu Jennæ.

source: Lumian’s curious gaze alternated between Hela and Franca a couple of times.
target: Oculus curiosus Lumiani inter Helam et Francam aliquoties alternavit.

source: He sensed that Madame Hela had something crucial to tell Franca but refrained from doing so.
target: Animadvertit Madama Helam aliquid grave Francæ habere dicendum, sed haec non narrare voluit.

source: It was rare for Lumian to perceive Madame Hela as having something on her mind.
target: Raro erat Lumiano Madama Helam aliquid in mente habere percipere.

source: Her glance at Franca and a few seconds of silence gave him the impression of hesitancy.
target: Aspectus eius ad Francam et paucis secundis silentii illi impressionem dubitationis dederunt.

source: Regrettably, Franca often has a carefree nature and doesn’t pay much attention to details.
target: Dolendum est quod Franca saepe naturæ levitas inest et parum ad minutias attendit.

source: Otherwise, she might be able to extract some information from her through direct questioning…
target: Alioquin, per quaestionem directam, fortasse aliqua indicia ab ea extrahere posset.

source: Lumian’s mind raced, and he concluded that if Madame Hela chose not to say anything at this point, she must have her reasons.
target: Mens Lumiani celeriter currit, atque concludit, si Madama Hela hisce verbis non loqui velit, rationes suas habere oportere.

source: Thus, he suppressed his curiosity and gestured towards the front of the dilapidated palace.
target: Itaque curiositatem suam repressit et ad frontem palatii ruentis signavit.

source: “I’ll get the ritual ready.”
target: “Ritum praeparabo.”

source: “Sounds good,” Franca responded with enthusiasm.
target: “Optime, sonat,” Franca cum fervore respondit.

source: While she had witnessed Lumian acquire Ascetic powers, that had taken place in Fourth Epoch Trier.
target: Dum ipsa testata fuit Lumiani, qui potestates asceticas adeptus est, id in Aetate Quarta Trier evenit.

source: A myriad of dangers had intertwined, causing her to shudder with fear.
target: Mira pericula inter se contexerant, quae eam metu concutere fecerunt.

source: She had to maintain constant vigilance of her surroundings, unable to “appreciate” the situation with the same level of ease as she could now.
target: Oportebat illi circumiecta constanter observare, neque rem tam facili modo frui, ut nunc possset.

source: After a moment of contemplation, Lumian retrieved a metal canister from a hidden pocket and tossed it to Franca.
target: Post paulum meditationis, Lumian vas metallum ex sinu abscondito extraxit et Francæ jecit.

source: “If things start going poorly for me later on, forcefully break through the wall of spirituality and throw this in front of me or on me.”
target: “Si res posthac mihi male eveniant, per vim parietem spiritualitatis rumpito et hoc coram me aut in me proice.”

source: “Should I unscrew the cap for you?” Franca asked, a smile playing on her lips.
target: “Num tibi operculum aperire debeam?” Franca, subrisu labris, quaesivit.

source: “What do you think?” Lumian arched an eyebrow.
target: “Quid censes?” Lumian unam supercilium levavit.

source: “Naturally,” Franca replied, her smile unwavering.
target: “Certe,” Franca respondit, risu immotum.

source: “I’m just trying to lighten the mood.”
target: Modo conor animum levare.

source: “I want you to feel at ease.”
target: Volo ut te in tranquillitate sentias.

source: “I appreciate it!” Lumian turned and made his way to the massive stone chair in the depths of the ancient palace.
target: “Gratias ago!” Lumian versa est atque iter fecit ad magnam cathedram lapideam in profundis antiqui palatii.

source: His intuition suggested that the huge, mottled stone chair might have a connection to Mr. Fool.
target: Intuitus eius praebebat magnam cathedram lapideam maculatam fortasse nexum habere cum Domine Stulto.

source: This would enable him to draw Mr. Fool’s attention during the impending ritual.
target: Hoc ei licebit ut attentionem Domini Stulti in ritu imminente attrahere possit.

source: As Franca and Hela watched Lumian arrange the corresponding items on the stone chair, setting it up as an altar and placing a Loen gold pound reverently in front of the grayish-white candle symbolizing the deity,
target: Dum Franca et Hela spectabant Lumian res pertinentes in cathedra lapidea disponere, eam ut aram constituens et librum aureum Loen in honore ante candelae cinereo-alba deum repraesentantem collocans,

source: Hela calmly remarked, “Don’t be concerned about not receiving a response. The secrets will remain secret, while the rest will be revealed.”
target: Hela tranquille inquit: “Noli solliciti esse de responsione carente; secreta secreta manebunt, cetera vero revelabuntur.”

source: Lumian felt himself relax as he consecrated the ritual silver dagger, erecting a wall of spirituality.
target: Lumian se relaxare sensit, dum hasta argentea ritu sacrata consecrabat et murum spiritualitatis erigebat.

source: The voices of Franca and Hela faded into the background, as if emanating from a great distance.
target: Voces Francæ et Helae in obscuritate evanuerunt, quasi ex longe provenire videbantur.

source: Rather than rushing into the ritual, Lumian lowered his voice and proactively provoked Termiboros.
target: Potius quam in ritu festinare, Lumian vocem deminuit et Termiboronem provocavit.

source: “I’m about to extract your power once more. Any thoughts on the matter?”
target: “Iam iterum potentiam tuam extrahere vado. Habesne quid de hac re?”

source: He aimed to enrage Termiboros to a certain degree.
target: Ad Termiboronem ad certum gradum irascendum contendebat.

source: Only then might Termiboros inadvertently expose any concealed issues in His response, allowing Lumian to discern whether this Inevitability Angel was secretly plotting something.
target: Tum tantum Termiboros fortuito quaedam occultata in responso suo revelare posset, sinens Lumiano discernere num hic Angelus Inevitabilitatis insidiis quidpiam pararet.

source: The sooner he uncovered it, the sooner he could address it and find a resolution!
target: Quo citius id detegit, eo citius id solvere et consilium invenire poterit!

source: Termiboros’s imposing voice resonated.
target: Vox immanis Termiboronis resonabat.

source: “The further you venture, the closer you draw to the end.
target: Quo longius progreditur, eo propius ad finem accedis.

source: This is an inevitability—irreversible.”
target: Hoc fatum est—irreversibile.

source: “Is that how you console yourself?” Lumian scoffed at Termiboros’s enigmatic behavior.
target: “Sic te consolari?” Lumian, Termiboronis enigmatico more despectans, irridit.

source: Termiboros’s voice reverberated within Lumian’s body.
target: Vox Termiboronis per corpus Lumiani resonabat.

source: “Boons bring the recipient closer to the bestower.”
target: Beneficia accipientem propius faciunt ad largientem.

source: “You may believe you’re extracting my power, but in truth, you’re steadily aligning your fate with mine, becoming more and more like me.”
target: Fortasse putas te potentiam meam extrahere, sed re vera fatum tuum meum constanter alligere, te magis et magis me simile reddere.

source: “This grants me glimpses through your eyes and your fate.”
target: Hoc mihi sinit per oculos tuos atque fatum tuum intuenda.

source: “You and I are merely bugs ensnared by fate.”
target: Tu et ego non nisi insecta sumus, fata nos alligantia.

source: "Apart from the greatest of existences, all living beings share this commonality."
target: Praeter maxima existentia, omnia entia viventia hanc similitudinem habent.

source: “In the near future, you will come to understand: “Death is the end of all things, and madness is an eternal melody.”
target: Mox intelleges: “Mors finis est omnium rerum, et insania aeternum carmen est.”

source: That’s essentially the same as saying nothing…
target: Id fere nihil dicere significat.

source: Is Termiboros implying that I will face a setback in the near future?
target: An Termiboros insinuit me in proximo tempore casum adversum passurum esse?

source: Lumian chuckled and said, “Are you deliberately saying this to make me obtain the power of a Fate Appropriator while burdened with worry and fear, hoping I’ll die here?”
target: Lumian risit et dixit: “Num propositum dicis hoc ut mihi potentiam Fati Appropriatoris largiaris, sollicitus et timens, sperans me hic moriturum esse?”

source: “Don’t concern yourself.”
target: “Noli te sollicitare.”

source: “Death and madness won’t deter me.”
target: “Mors et insania me non detinent.”

source: Without awaiting Termiboros’s reply, Lumian fixed his gaze upon the candle flame and recited in a deep, resonant voice, “Power of Inevitability!”
target: Nisi responsum Termiboronis exspectans, Lumian oculum ad flammam candelae fixit et voce profunda resonante recitavit: “Potentia Inevitabilitatis!”

source: “You are the past, the present, and the future;”
target: “Tu es praeteritum, praesens, et futurum;”

source: “You are the cause, the effect, and the process;”
target: “Tu es causa, effectus, et processus;”

source: As the ritual progressed, Franca and Hela bore witness to the transformation of all the items on the altar.
target: Dum ritu procedebat, Franca et Hela transformationem omnium rerum in ara conspectae sunt.

source: Stones softened, candles expanded, and the ground decayed into a swamp.
target: Lapis mollivit, candelae expansae sunt, et terra in paludem corrupta est.

source: Countless strange insects loomed in the void.
target: Innumerabiles insecta mirabilia in inania eminuerunt.

source: The darkness outside the dilapidated palace intensified.
target: Tenebrae extra palatium lapsum intensiores factae sunt.

source: A silver‑black liquid flowed from Lumian’s chest, enveloping him like corrupted mercury.
target: Liquidum argentum‑nigrum ex pectore Lumiani fluxit, eum quasi mercurii corrupti involvens.

source: Lumian writhed in agony.
target: Lumian in dolore contortus est.

source: Throughout this process, his body alternated between contortion and normalcy, occasionally assuming postures that defied human anatomy.
target: Per hoc processum, corpus eius inter contorsionem et statum ordinarium alternabat, interdum habitus capiens qui anatomia humanam repugnant.

source: It was as though he were boneless, his skin and flesh infused with mercury.
target: Sicut sine ossibus esset, cutis et caro eius mercurio infusae erant.

source: Franca was startled and experienced an inexplicable, illusory pain.
target: Franca territa est et dolorem inenarrabilem, illusorium, sensit.

source: Amidst the excruciating and familiar pain, Lumian caught sight of Aurore.
target: Inter dolorem acerbum et notum, Lumian Aurorem animadvertit.

source: Aurore, with her thick, long blond hair, was attempting the Soul Summoning Spell!
target: Aurore, cum capillis fulvis crassis et longis, incantationem animarum evocandi conabatur!

source: Lumian stepped forward and intervened, stopping Aurore.
target: Lumian procedit et intervenit, Aurorem sistens.

source: Just as he rejoiced in the belief that the problem had been nipped in the bud and Aurore wouldn’t fracture into the evil personality of Roche Louise Sanson, he was horrified to discover that Aurore’s body had undergone a drastic transformation.
target: Mox, cum gaudebat credens problema in initio compositum esse et Aurore non in malam indolem Roche Louise Sanson degeneraturum esse, horridus invenit corpus eius transformationem radicalem subisse.

source: In a bloody state, she had expanded into a monster with three heads and six arms, sitting cross‑legged.
target: In statu sanguineo, expandit in monstrum tribus capitibus et sexque brachiis, sedens in cruce crurium.

source: Lumian witnessed Aurore seeking assistance from Hela.
target: Lumian conspexit Aurorem auxilium a Hela petentem.

source: Reluctantly, he offered his help, preventing his sister from forgetting this matter.
target: Reticentia, auxilium suum obtulit, ne sororem de hac re oblivisci sineret.

source: However, when Hela arrived, Aurore had already transformed into a colossal three‑headed, six‑armed monster, despite the final ritual not having been performed.
target: Sed, cum Hela advenisset, Aurore iam in monstrum colossale, tribus capitibus sexque brachiis, transmutata erat, quamquam ritu finali non peracto fuisse.

source: Aurore, at various stages of life, appeared before Lumian.
target: Aurore, variis vitae gradibus, ante Lumian apparuit.

source: They were on the verge of making pivotal choices.
target: Illi in limine decisionum gravium erant.

source: Lumian desperately tried to alter the Aurores’ fates and prevent them from descending into the abyss.
target: Lumian vehementer temptavit fata Auroræ mutare et impediere ne in abyssum demergerent.

source: However, each time, although he managed to redirect fate to another tributary, Aurore’s spirit and flesh ultimately crumbled, transforming her into a three‑headed, six‑armed monster.
target: Sed quovis tempore, licet fatum ad alium fluminis affluentem converteret, spiritus atque caro Aurore denique corruerunt, eam in monstrum tribus capitibus sexque brachiis transformantes.

source: Is this inevitability?
target: Hocne fatum est?

source: Is this an irreversible outcome?
target: Hocne exitus irreversibilis est?

source: Lumian’s eyes turned bloodshot as he made increasingly futile efforts.
target: Oculi Lumiani in rubore sanguineo versuti sunt, dum conatus eius magis magisque frustra erant.

source: At that instant, he caught a whiff of an elegant and sweet scent, and a soothing chant echoed in his ears.
target: Illo momento, fragrans odor elegans et dulcis pervagatus est, atque cantus mollis in auribus eius resonabat.

source: Lumian quickly regained his senses and clarity of mind.
target: Lumian celeriter sensus suos et luciditatem mentis recuperavit.

source: The Aurores before him abruptly vanished, leaving only the quietly burning candle flames.
target: Aurores ante eum repente evanuerunt, relinquentes tantum flammas candelae tranquille ardentes.

source: Instinctively, Lumian glanced behind him and realized that Franca and Hela were nearby.
target: Instinctu, Lumian retrospiciens animadvertit Francam et Helam prope esse.

source: The wall of spirituality had been shattered.
target: Murus spiritualitatis dirutus erat.

source: Simultaneously, Franca observed the flickering silver and iron‑black colors in Lumian’s eyes before they merged and settled into a silvery‑black hue.
target: Simul, Franca animadvertit micantia colores argenteo et ferro nigri in oculis Lumiani, qui ante confluentes in unam umbram argenteo‑nigrum consederunt.

source: Lumian exhaled, recognizing that he had evaded danger and successfully acquired the power of a Fate Appropriator.
target: Lumian suspiravit, agnovens se periculum evaserit et potentiam Fati Appropriatoris feliciter adeptum esse.

source: Yet, a profound sense of frustration and disappointment lingered within him.
target: Attamen, profunda frustratio et desperatio in eo manebant.

source: What he had just experienced in the illusion seemed to foretell the ultimate outcome of his desire to resurrect Aurore.
target: Id quod modo in illusione expertus erat, videtur praenuntiare exitum ultimum eius desiderii Aurorem resurrectionis.

source: After ten to twenty seconds, Lumian finally broke free from those emotions and regained his determination.
target: Post decem ad viginti secundas, Lumian tandem his affectibus evasit et propositum suum recuperavit.

source: How could anyone give up without even trying!
target: Quomodo quisquam sine conatu deficere potest!

source: Franca breathed a sigh of relief, screwed the cap back on, and asked with a smile, “How did it go? Any new abilities?”
target: Franca suspiravit leviter, operculum redegit, et cum risu quaesivit: “Quomodo fuit? Novae virtutes suntne?”

source: You really don’t consider yourself an outsider.
target: Revera te extraneum non censes.

source: How can you nonchalantly inquire about someone’s new Beyonder powers?
target: Quomodo licet tibi tranquille interrogare de novis viribus Beyonder alicuius?

source: Lumian silently criticized Franca as he meticulously observed his transformation.
target: Lumian Francam silentio reprehendit, dum diligenter transformationem suam observabat.

source: His eyes, which had just returned to normal, once again turned silvery‑black, reflecting the images of Franca and Hela.
target: Oculi eius, qui modo ad statum normalem redierant, iterum in umbram argenteo‑nigrum conversa sunt, imagines Francæ et Helae reflectentes.

source: Then, he perceived the mercury‑colored illusory river that corresponded to the two ladies.
target: Deinde percipuit flumen illusorium colore mercurii, quod illis duabus congruens erat.

source: He saw the sparkling light representing their past and present river trunks and the numerous tributaries that had branched off from the present.
target: Vidit lumen effulgens, quod repraesentabat radices fluminum pristinarum et praesentium, atque innumerabiles affluentes, qui ex praesenti divergebant.

source: The illusory river slowly advanced, devouring all the tributaries, leaving only one behind, transforming it into the main bulk.
target: Flumen illusorium lente procedebat, omnes affluentes devorans, unum tantum relinquens, illud in corpus principale convertens.

source: The main bulk continued to split into new tributaries…
target: Corpus principale in novas affluentes dividere pergebat…

source: Lumian noticed that one of the tributaries, regardless of whether it belonged to Franca or Hela, emitted a faint black hue.
target: Lumian animadvertit unum ex affluentibus, quod sive Francæ sive Helae pertineret, levem nigram colorem emittentem.
